SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CustomerID),2) 
FROM yearmonth 
JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID 
WHERE Segment = 'LAM'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM customers c INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
